title: Failure Chorus: unified error topology, tracehook enrichment & dashboards
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Goal: Create a single, queryable error topology across the Redwood inference stack that standardizes failure taxonomy (timeouts, overload, model errors, HTTP/gRPC codes) and wires tracehook enrichment into the metrics/log pipeline so dashboards and alerts can drive faster oncall resolution and SLO insights. Scope includes: (1) tracehook span attribute contract, (2) log/metrics mapping and ingestion rules for the error index, (3) a set of Grafana dashboard templates (service-level error matrix, model-error breakdown, overload and queueing heatmaps), and (4) rollout plan (staging -> canary -> global). This ticket coordinates work across runtime, edge, and observability infra teams.
acceptance_criteria: Tracehook middleware emits standardized attributes: error.class, error.reason, model.exit_code, grpc_code, http_status, queue_time_ms, runtime_queue_len, downstream_latency_ms
Log pipeline Rule: error index entries are created for all enriched traces and map to canonical taxonomy tags (timeout | overload | model_error | client_error | infra_error)

Dashboards: templated Grafana panels available in Observatory with filters for route/model/region and show 30d trends; must include error-rate-by-failure-type, P95 latency waterfall, queue-length heatmap
SLO/alerts: Example alert for >5% error-rate-by-failure-type (1h) and composite alert for overload signals (queue_time_ms > 100ms & runtime_queue_len spike)
Runbook & Oncall: Playbook page drafted with quick triage steps and linked runbook snippets for reset/retry/scale actions
End-to-end test: Synthetic trace generator produces example traces for each failure class that are correctly classified and shown in dashboards
tasks: Define tracehook span contract and publish JSON schema in Confluence
Instrument runtime and edge to emit new attributes (iterative: staging first)
Add mapping rules to telemetry pipeline to populate error index and derived metrics
Build initial Grafana templates and import to Observatory namespace
Create synthetic trace harness + unit tests
Document rollout plan and coordinate canary with Dedicated infra team
Ship PR for runtime changes and telemetry mapping (link in comments)
decisions: Taxonomy: canonical buckets will be timeout, overload, model_error, client_error (4 buckets) with sub-reasons attached as tags
Backpressure signal: treat sustained runtime_queue_len > threshold as overload source rather than downstream timeout
Model errors: model.exit_code numeric values will be mapped to human-readable reasons in the enrichment layer to avoid downstream parsing
risks: Noise: naive classification may spike false positives until mapping tuned; mitigated by phased canary and adjustable thresholds
Cardinality: attaching route+model+region+reason increases metrics/cardinality; mitigate by rolling up to derived metrics and limiting label permutations
Telemetry lag: enrichment must be near real-time; if pipeline introduces delays dashboards will be less useful for oncall
